stem: 风险偏好声明的目的在于:

options.A: 明确界定金融机构愿意承担的金融犯罪风险敞口水平.
options.B: 帮助投资者了解金融机构愿意承担的风险.
options.C: 帮助客户了解哪些金融机构可能愿意为其提供银行服务.
options.D: 从金融机构中剔除高风险业务类型.

stem_en: The purpose of a risk appetite statement is to:

options_en.A: Clearly define the level of risk exposure to financial crime that a financial institution is willing to take
options_en.B: Help investors understand the risk a financial institution is willing to take
options_en.C: Help customers understand which financial institutions may be willing to bank their business
options_en.D: Eliminate high-risk business types from a financial institution
